text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I bought so much stuff♪
Totally satisfied♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, is it really that late already!?
I'm cutting it super close for training!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still, well, as long as I go with Tacchan, it'll be a breeze♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've made it in the nick of time before,
so let's just enjoy the thrill instead♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm gonna go all out and blast right ahead!
"...Maruzensky climbed into her beloved car, but..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo, why is traffic this backed up?!
I gotta find another route!

Maruzensky sped down an unfamiliar road
and didn't make it in time for that day's training.
